newsitem.title: MOROCCO: Morocco's CGEM business group re-appoints president.
newsitem.headline: Morocco's CGEM business group re-appoints president.

text.p: Morocco's CGEM business confederation on Thursday re-appointed wealthy businessman Abderrahim Lahjouji as its president, a spokesman said.

"Lahjouji, who was the only candidate, was re-appointed for three years by a majority of 430 votes while 30 members abstained," the spokesman for the Confederation Generale des Entreprises du Maroc (CGEM) said.
Lahjouji, 55, is also the managing-director of SOTRAVO, a leading contruction firm in Morocco.
